title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Billing Ruling: Sharing Storage Goodwill Between Insurer and Owner
content:
**Ruling.** On a Repair Estimates & Appointments insurance-claim booking, how the goodwill booked on the storage charge is shared follows the booking's state:

- on a booking whose decline request is confirmed the goodwill comes off the owner's part first, up to the whole owner's part;
- on a booking in expired status the goodwill comes off the insurer's part first and only what exceeds the insurer's part comes off the owner's part;
- on every other booking this ruling sets no order of sharing.

**Owner's share of the goodwill under the ruling**

| Booking state | Owner's share |
|---|---|
| Decline request confirmed | The goodwill, but no more than the owner's part |
| Expired | The goodwill less the insurer's part, where that is above zero; otherwise nothing |

**Worked figures** (hypothetical: goodwill booked on the storage charge 40.00 USD)

| Booking state | Owner's part | Insurer's part | Owner's share of the goodwill | Owner's part less that share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Decline confirmed | 240.00 USD | 360.00 USD | 40.00 USD | 200.00 USD |
| Decline confirmed | 25.00 USD | 575.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Expired | 120.00 USD | 30.00 USD | 10.00 USD | 110.00 USD |
| Expired | 120.00 USD | 480.00 USD | nothing | 120.00 USD |
